screens.title: Screens
screens.description: The titles of the workspace's screens, from the screen catalogue (GET /meta/handbook and the MCP server give each screen in full)

also_uses.title: Also Uses
also_uses.description: Screen ids of other workspaces its roles work in (the cashier: my_cash_shift, cash_back_prompts)

every_employee.title: Every Employee
every_employee.description: True for My Workspace (self_service): every user with an employee record has it, whatever their roles (GET /auth/workspaces lists it for them)

guest.title: Guest
guest.description: True for the PHC inspector's workspace: its logins are guests without an employee record, so they have no My Workspace
